title: AQ CapabilityLease shadow issuance record (Foundation C1 — SHADOW / LOG-ONLY)
description: One JSONL entry emitted by scripts/ai/aq-capability-shadow. Report-only: records the CapabilityLease that WOULD be issued (or the denial that WOULD apply) for a given aq-capability-intake admission verdict. Never consumed by any enforcement path in this slice — see .agents/plans/aqos-foundation-c/C1-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC.md.

ts.description: When this shadow decision was computed.

candidate_id.description: The aq-capability-intake candidate id this record was computed for.

admission.description: The admission verdict as returned by aq-capability-intake audit_candidate() (e.g. low-risk, accepted-with-mitigations, review-recommended, needs-review, blocked). Not restricted to a fixed enum here so an unrecognized/future admission value still validates as a would-deny record rather than failing schema validation.

would_issue.description: Whether the shadow policy would issue a lease for this admission verdict.

lease.description: The signed CapabilityLease that WOULD be issued, or null when would_issue is false.

deny_reason.description: Set when would_issue is false (e.g. needs-review, blocked, unknown-admission:<value>); null when a lease was issued.

risk_flags.description: The risk_flags carried on the source audit result at the time this shadow decision was computed.

dev_key.description: True when the C0 DEV signing key (capability_lease.DEV_SIGNING_KEY) was used, or would have been used, to sign this decision's lease — never a trust-rooted signature. Present on every record (issued or denied) so a caller can tell a dev-signed shadow lease apart without inspecting the signature itself.
